title: Equatorial Guinea calculator readiness — Batch 48
purpose: Advance source verification for crop output, regional agricultural statistics and farm-gate price evidence; do not publish estimates without underlying rows.

confirmed_findings.source: INEGE Statistical Yearbook of Equatorial Guinea 2026
confirmed_findings.finding: Official five-year statistical compilation covers agriculture, prices, income and wages; selected sectors have regional/provincial/district disaggregation.
confirmed_findings.qualification: Accessible landing page describes coverage but does not expose crop table values in its text; download and extract full electronic yearbook.

confirmed_findings.source: Government of Equatorial Guinea official press office
confirmed_findings.finding: Official yearbook launch report identifies the First General Agricultural Census as a forthcoming statistical operation.
confirmed_findings.qualification: No census results or completion date are provided; this is a future data opportunity, not current production evidence.

confirmed_findings.finding: Dataset metadata defines producer prices as farm-gate/first-sale prices, annual series 1991–2025 and monthly series from 2010, with price units including local currency per tonne.
confirmed_findings.qualification: Equatorial Guinea commodity rows have not been extracted; no country price value admitted.

confirmed_findings.source: FAO GIEWS Equatorial Guinea Country Brief
confirmed_findings.finding: FAO reports 2024 production estimates of 102,000 tonnes sweet potato, 77,000 tonnes cassava and 41,000 tonnes plantain, plus approx 20,000 ha staple crops and 9,000 ha cash crops.
confirmed_findings.qualification: Production aggregates only; no matched harvested area or crop-specific province yield in this batch. Land-use definitions conflict with prior FAO brief and remain unresolved.

confirmed_findings.source: World Bank Trading Agricultural Commodities in CEMAC
confirmed_findings.finding: Historical cross-border market-chain price formation for tomato, plantain and maize along Cameroon–Equatorial Guinea trade routes.
confirmed_findings.qualification: Historical border/urban prices are not current Equatorial Guinea farm-gate prices; excluded from calculator inputs.

pending_extraction: INEGE 2026 yearbook electronic PDF/annexes: agriculture, producer/market prices, wages, province/district tables.
FAOSTAT QCL country rows: crop area harvested, production, yield, flags and notes.
FAOSTAT producer prices country/product rows: local currency, unit, latest observation year/month, flags and missing series.
Primary government gazette/ministry validation of any 2026/27 cocoa price schedule and grade/payment rules.
Current province-level farmer input quotations and crop/livestock enterprise budgets.

regional_structure.status: geography retained from prior 2026 official toponymic evidence; no provincial crop yields yet validated

decision: Do not activate Equatorial Guinea. Current FAO output totals and the INEGE cocoa growth signal do not provide crop-specific regional yields or budgets. No guessed values, old 2018 trade prices or national aggregates have been admitted as calculator inputs.
next_step: Extract full INEGE yearbook agriculture and price tables and raw FAOSTAT crop/producer-price country rows; then validate dated provincial producer prices and farm input budgets.
